cards.name: hero
cards.question: Blur Image Online
cards.answer: Pixelate or Hide Faces, Plates & Text
cards.qualifier: Drag over a face, a license plate or a name to blur, pixelate or cover it with a solid bar, then download the photo at full size. Your photo never leaves your device.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: Blur an image in three steps

steps.title: Draw the areas to hide
steps.text: Drag on the photo to cover an area.

cards.name: pixelate-image-areas-blur
cards.title: Pixelate image areas, blur them or use a solid bar

groups.label: How to pixelate an image
groups.text: Choose Pixelate and set Block size between 5 and 60.

groups.label: Blur strength
groups.text: Choose Blur and set Blur strength between 2 and 50.

groups.label: Why a solid bar is safest for text
groups.text: For names, number plates and other text.

groups.label: Overlapping areas stay hidden
groups.text: Each area is applied on top of the photo as it already is.

cards.name: blur-faces-in-a
cards.title: Blur faces in a photo before you post

groups.label: How to blur a face in a photo
How to censor a license plate
groups.text: Choose Rectangle and Solid bar, then drag over the plate with a small margin.

cards.name: full-size-download-and
cards.title: Full-size download, and no hidden location data

groups.label: EXIF and GPS data are removed
groups.text: The download is a newly drawn image.

groups.label: JPG or PNG
groups.text: JPG gives smaller files and suits photos.
